newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends up as call rates rise sharply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends up as call rates rise sharply.

text.p: Higher call rates in the money market pushed the Bangladesh taka up to 43.6500/7450 to the dollar at the close in interbank trading on Wednesday, against the previous 43.7440/7490, dealers said.
Dealers said the taka edged higher after opening at 43.7370/7420 mainly because of the surge in call money rates to 30-40 percent from the previous 8-10 percent.
There was little demand for dollars in the market ahead of the three-day Moslem Eid al-Adha festival beginning on Thursday.
